title: Savings Shipyard: Initiative Tracker for Targeted Token Reduction Experiments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a coordinated portfolio of small, high-confidence experiments aimed at shaving per-request token cost without degrading 95th-percentile latency or generation quality. Bundle field trials across batching heuristics, KV cache TTL policies, and targeted quantization profiles into a single tracking ticket so PM/Eng/Design can observe combined economics impact, gate rollouts, and capture learnings for broader rollout in Dedicated and Private tiers.
objectives: Reduce average token compute cost by 12% across sampled workloads within 8 weeks
Maintain 95th pct latency within current SLO (<= 350ms for short-form requests)
Provide reproducible experiment recipes and dashboards for ops to adopt successful knobs
Produce a rollout decision rubric for Dedicated and Private customers with documented guardrails
milestones: M1: Experiment definitions and measurement plan complete (2025-02-20)
M2: Canary experiments deployed to sandbox and internal beta (2025-03-05)
M3: Data collection and analysis phase complete (2025-03-25)
M4: Decision and rollout plan for successful knobs (2025-04-10)
M5: Rollout to non-production Dedicated pools & docs (2025-04-25)
sub_issues: PM-46220 - Define benchmark prompt set and failure modes
PM-46221 - Telemetry dashboard: cost by model/route/quant-profile
PM-46222 - Canary rollout and rollback automation
ENG-46225 - Implement dynamic KV TTL and expose control plane config
acceptance_criteria: A1: Measured token cost delta with confidence intervals for each experiment arm
A2: No >5% increase in user-visible error rate or hallucination score across test prompts
A3: Latency SLOs preserved for 95th percentile on sampled routes
A4: Operational runbook and gating checklist for rollouts added to Confluence
